name: dental-explainer
description: Turns any dental concept into an accurate, interactive 3D figure: exploded views, cross-sections, implants, endo, perio, restorations. Built from real millimetre dimensions and a verified dental facts file.

interface.longDescription:
Dental Explainer turns a dental concept into an accurate 3D figure, delivered as an image or an interactive page (video is coming soon). It covers exploded views of implants and restorations, tooth cross-sections, root and canal anatomy, numbering charts and procedure steps such as implant placement or a crown preparation.

Every model is built from real millimetre dimensions and checked against a verified dental facts file, so the anatomy, numbering (FDI and Universal) and implant rules are right. It is made for dentists, dental students and patient educators who need a figure for a lecture, a patient conversation or social media.

Ask in plain words, for example "Show an exploded view of an implant replacing 36". The assistant asks which format you want unless you say.

Limitations: figures are parametric and population-average, not built from a patient's scans or radiographs. Soft tissue is schematic, and implants are drawn generically without brand geometry. Interactive pages load three.js from cdnjs.cloudflare.com; the plugin sends no data anywhere.
capabilities: 3D dental figures as an image or interactive page
Exploded views, cross-sections and procedure steps
defaultPrompt: Show an exploded view of an implant replacing 36
Why does MB2 get missed in upper first molars? Cut through the tooth
Root-filled premolar with fibre post, core and crown, for patients

publication.release_notes: Figures now look right on iPhone and Safari, drilling and fillings animate live, and a new jaw-movement model (working vs non-working condyle).
